newsitem.title: USA: Knogo, Video Sentry to merge.
newsitem.headline: Knogo, Video Sentry to merge.

text.p: Security systems companies Knogo North America Inc. and Video Sentry Corp. said Thursday they have agreed to merge to form a new firm to be called Sentry Technology Corp.
Long Island, N.Y.-based Knogo is a leading manufacturer of electronic article surveillance systems. Video Senty, headquarted in in Minneapolis, makes video security systems.

Under the merger, Sentry will issue one share of common stock for each share of Video Sentry common stock. Sentry will issue 1 share of common stock and 1 share of Class A Preferred Stock for each 1.2022 shares of Knogo common stock.

There will be about 9.6 million shares of Sentry common stock -- 51 percent owned by former Video Sentry shareholders and 49 percent owned by former Knogo shareholders -- and 4.8 million shares of Sentry Class A Preferred Stock outstanding, all owned by former Knogo shareholders.
